display.purpose: Large roman first name and burgundy italic surname on the homepage.

title.purpose: A paper, talk or CV entry title.

motion.name: control-state
motion.purpose: Color and border transitions on buttons when reduced motion has not been requested.

components.name: Primary action
components.description: Main action in the academic profile.
components.css: .ds-action{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:2.8rem;padding:.58rem 1.08rem;border:1px solid var(--wine,#7b2d3b);background:var(--wine,#7b2d3b);color:var(--paper,#fafaf7);border-radius:3px;font:600 .91rem/1.65 var(--body,'DM Sans',Arial,sans-serif);text-decoration:none}.ds-action:hover{background:var(--ink,#201f20);border-color:var(--ink,#201f20)}.ds-action:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--wine,#7b2d3b);outline-offset:4px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.ds-action{transition:color 150ms ease-out,background-color 150ms ease-out,border-color 150ms ease-out}}

components.name: Publication search
components.description: A permanently labeled field for filtering preprints and papers.
components.html: <label class="ds-search">Search publications<input type="search" placeholder="Title, author or venue"></label>
components.css: .ds-search{display:block;color:var(--ink,#201f20);font:600 .9rem/1.65 var(--body,'DM Sans',Arial,sans-serif)}.ds-search input{display:block;width:100%;margin-top:.35rem;min-height:2.8rem;padding:.6rem .85rem;background:var(--paper,#fafaf7);color:inherit;border:1px solid var(--strong-line,#87817c);border-radius:2px;font:400 1rem/1.65 var(--body,'DM Sans',Arial,sans-serif)}.ds-search input::placeholder{color:var(--muted,#555452);opacity:1}.ds-search input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--wine,#7b2d3b);outline-offset:4px}

components.name: Paper resource
components.description: Underlined text for an available paper resource.

narrative.overview: The profile pairs an authentic studio portrait with an editorial nameplate. In the bibliography, CV and archive, fine rules and date columns organize the records.
keyCharacteristics: Local serif, sans-serif and monospaced typefaces
